subject: Customer endorsement request — sensitivity review before publish
messages:
From: Kate Morales <kate@averytech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer endorsement draft + permission to publish

Hi Ben and Monica,

Thanks again for a great partnership — the team at Avery Tech is happy with the performance gains after moving our search rerankers to Redwood. We drafted a short endorsement we can share on Redwood's site and social channels; attached is the PDF with the proposed quote and a couple of headshots.

Small note: we had a support incident in late May that caused a brief outage for one of our internal teams. That has been resolved, but leadership asked me to confirm whether publishing a testimonial right after that would be okay. Could you advise if Redwood has any internal policy about timing/publishing in cases where a customer recently experienced an incident? If not, we understand and can confirm on our side once we get the green light.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- You review the attached quote and attribution
- If acceptable, announce with a short social post and a blog highlight

Attached: avery_testimonial_draft.pdf (quote + headshots)

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Kate Morales
Marketing Program Manager
Avery Tech

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Customer endorsement draft + permission to publish

Hi team — quick internal summary after checking CS and account health:

- Incident summary: In late May Avery experienced a ~45 minute degradation affecting one internal workflow. The issue was traced to a misconfigured routing rule on their side; our team provided a fix and follow-up diagnostics. Avery's SLAs are fine and they are not currently on any retention or remediation plan.
- Current account health: No open severity-1 tickets. Customer sentiment is neutral-positive; product usage dipped for two days but has recovered. There is no active churn intent logged in our CRM, but the account owner did flag sensitivity to external comms until leadership confirms they’re comfortable.

Recommendation (from CS):
1) Ask Avery for a short confirmation sentence that leadership is OK publishing given the incident has been resolved. This keeps the decision on the customer and reduces risk.
2) If they prefer us to wait, propose a short embargo window (7–14 days) after which we can revisit.
3) Use the attached comms_template.docx for the social/blog copy to avoid implying broader stability problems.

From a customer-success point of view I wouldn’t recommend publishing immediately without that explicit leadership sign-off. Happy to draft the message and send it to marketing/legal for approval.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Attachment: comms_template.docx

----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Morales <kate@averytech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Customer endorsement draft + permission to publish

Hi Kate — thanks for sending this over and for the context. Appreciate the transparency.

Quick update from our side after consulting CS and legal: we’d like an explicit confirmation from Avery leadership that they’re comfortable with Redwood publishing the endorsement now that the May incident has been resolved. That keeps everything clear on both sides and avoids any perception that the testimonial downplays recent operational events.

If leadership is comfortable, a single sentence like this would work: "Avery Tech confirms Redwood's testimonial reflects our current experience and we are comfortable with Redwood publishing this endorsement."

If you’d rather delay, we propose a short embargo of 7 days to let things fully settle and for your team to complete any internal sign-offs. Either option is fine with us — please let me know which you prefer and I’ll coordinate the rest (social copy, blog post, image captions).

Thanks again — great to see the team happy with the results.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
+1 617-555-0103
